card.name: Linking words before seizure type terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets (and, or, with, an opening parenthesis) in seizure and epilepsy text, right before a seizure type such as petit mal, complex, generalized or tonic-clonic.

modes.label: After absence
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or 'with' right after 'absence', before petit mal.
modes.example: when other forms of epilepsy coexist with absence<< (>>petit mal).

modes.label: Between seizure types
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' joining seizure types, before the second type.
modes.example: o Simple<< and>> Complex Absence Seizures: Initial

modes.label: Dosing heading
modes.description: 'for' in a dosing heading before a named seizure type.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward seizure type words such as generalized and tonic.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before a seizure type is named.
